'''MrDeath My first deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[MrDeath]]
* '''Published:''' 2 August 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 CCT MrDeath DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Ket Maliss (V), Special Delivery (V), Jabba's Influence (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Bane Malar (V), Guri (V), The Emperor (V), Krayt Dragon Bones (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Despair (V), Blaster Rack (V): no GEMP blueprint)

Under Fear Is My Ally: '8 shield, 2 Bubo'; no shields named.

== Notes ==

* Posted line 'Vader with StickIg With' read as Darth Vader With Lightsaber plus a stray 'Ig With' fragment (the later 'IG with' line is IG-88 With Riot Gun); this matches Characters (21).
* Two Bubo under Fear Is My Ally, outside the 60.
* Shorthand dests: 'Bossk with' Bossk With Mortar Gun, 'Dengar With' Dengar With Blaster Carbine, '4-Lom with' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, 'Zuckuss in'/'Bossk in' the pilot-in-ship cards, 'DS: DB' Death Star: Docking Bay 327, 'Sniper kombó' Sniper & Dark Strike, 'MM' Masterful Move (unsure: could be the Endor Occupation combo).
* Original-era (V) slips: Ket Maliss (VS3), Special Delivery/Jabba's Influence/Lando/The Emperor/Ability x3/Despair (VS6), Bane Malar/Guri (VS7), Krayt Dragon Bones (VS4), Desilijic Tattoo (VS5), Blaster Rack (VS1, wiki-tagged Light).
